p.i: Apud Hebraeos nomina non variantur de casu in casum, sed mutantur duntaxat de singulari numero in pluralem. Nonnunquam tamen, sed non constanter & perpetuo, casus obliqui exprimuntur, praepositis quibusdam servilibus consonis, invariata Nominis terminatione, in hunc modum:

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dageshes are read from a low-resolution scan and may not be exact; the case labels are copied as printed (the ablative is marked "A." in the print). The page number is printed in an old figure style with a leading ornament; read as 230. The last line (vocative plural) has no Latin gloss in the print. Some Latin glosses (e.g. "verborū", "ô", "à") have diacritics that are hard to confirm at this resolution.
